name: B10-0132/2026 (ECR) – Post-election situation in Uganda and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election situation in Uganda and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Uganda's January 2026 elections, which it says were marred by irregularities, and on the treatment of opposition leader Bobi Wine. It condemns threats and violence against him and his supporters, and it asks Uganda's government to protect political opponents, stop arbitrary arrests and forced disappearances, release people held without cause, and investigate abuses. It also urges African and international bodies to watch the situation closely.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- It concerns Uganda's government, security forces, opposition leaders and supporters.
- Next, the resolution is sent to Uganda, the African Union, the East African Community and the United Nations.
